resolvedFindings.resolution: Exact source point title, n-gon elements and n(n−3)/2 with explicit double-count proof added; all-five-diagonal scene and updated five-step flow inspected.
Neutral and step 1 show equal-diagonal hypothesis without right-angle conclusions; four right-angle marks only appear after the second proof step.
Neutral has no equal-side conclusion; two distinct given-condition scenes at step 0 show perpendicular diagonals or bisector. Equal-side marks appear in proved steps.
Fourth actual step uses the normalized square geometry, also available as square case, not the oblique rhombus.

limitations: This is complete static visual and mathematical review of 30 theory/selfcheck cards, not a claim of manually exercising every browser interaction or reviewing exercise-solution mathematics. Runtime interaction verification and 108 exercise-card proofs are separate reviews.

finalCaptureComparison.result: PASS: all differing final whole PNG hashes either exactly match an inspected representative or were newly visually inspected. No perceptual equivalence accepted.
